notes: Hide-and-seek is Party & Casual's Childhood Game preset, and candy land is a theme on top of it rather than a second genre. The answers put it in one playground-sized area, so space-bounded — the gathering space is the play space — and not space-staged, since the genre's own note says a single continuous party space does not need an isolated stage and forcing one would cost P4 for nothing. I kept the preset whole: cover-los as dense candy clutter, gumdrop bushes and lollipop groves breaking sightlines, obstacle-maze as candy-cane hedgerow lanes to be hunted through, and social-hub because the answers confirm timed rounds with a seeker chosen each round, which needs somewhere to gather between them; obstacle-maze is what puts P6 on the route, and that is right here because a hiding warren has to be genuinely traversable. Added beyond the preset: trigger-scoring, the volume that registers a tag and ends a round; and without a user I read the maze as open-air candy hedges rather than interior corridors, so nothing goes indoors and no P3 is needed.
